chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me of it, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿĀmir, from Ḥajjāj al-Khashshāb, from Abī Hilāl, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: As for the menstruating woman, I drink from the remainder of her drink, but I do not like to perform wudu (ablution) from it.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman referred to in the ruling
key_terms.شَرَابِهَا: her drink or drinking vessel's remaining contents
key_terms.فَضْلِ: the remainder or leftover of what has been used

ai.seo_question: Can one drink from or perform wudu (ablution) with the leftover water of a menstruating woman?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling on the leftover drink of a menstruating woman. It indicates that her leftover drink is not treated as impure for drinking, while expressing dislike regarding using it for wudu (ablution).
